: Synthesized 2026-11-16 from Anthropic's published example "Streaming
: request with web search tool use",
: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/streaming
: (see also "Streaming server-tool events",
: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/server-tools).
: Events are copied as published; the doc's `...` elisions are dropped
: (one search result kept, text block 3 closed early). The provider runs
: the server_tool_use at index 1 and streams its input as input_json_delta;
: the web_search_tool_result at index 2 arrives whole. Nothing here is a
: client tool call: every event must pass through unchanged.
